create.title: Masked alpha cosine-comb reduction and zero arithmetic-pole ownership
create.statement_tex: On the common finite endpoint-free antecedent put A=s-z/2 and B=s+z/2. Against compact smooth Mellin tests, the unmasked inverse Mellin transform of X_zeta(A)zeta(A) is the positive Dirac comb on Re A<0 and the comb minus one, equivalently 2 sum_(h>=1) cos(2 pi hY), on Re A>0. The difference is Res_(A=0) zeta(1-A)=-1; A=1 is removable. For the actual hierarchical alpha mask Theta_alpha=(1-psi(beta))psi(alpha), multiplication in beta is logarithmic-Mellin convolution and every finite displacement retains its Cauchy-Pompeiu or two strip-edge connectors, outside faces, axes, and one corner. Since psi=1 near zero, Theta_alpha and its first and mixed outside-axis connector derivatives vanish at A=0, so alpha owns no new R1 arithmetic residue. Integer cosine coherence and the interior stationary point of sqrt(Xx)-hx/t reject coefficientwise cancellation and uniform radial integration by parts. This is an exact reduction and no-go result, not an estimate of the alpha branch.
create.next_action: Use the exact mask/residue/comb architecture to derive the high-pass log-dilation commutator on the complete common antecedent; do not replace the masked alpha share by the pure comb.

update.statement_tex: Put A=s-z/2 and B=s+z/2. The exact alpha arithmetic factor is X_zeta(A)zeta(A)L(1-B,chi_4), with unsigned high coefficients h^(-A). By M9-M1-alpha-masked-cosine-comb-reduction, its unmasked zeta factor is distributionally a Dirac comb or cosine comb with the A=0 constant mode already owned by the accepted R1 module; the actual hierarchical alpha share is instead a logarithmic-Mellin projection. Prove that the complete projected cosine-Cauchy/GAR-return operator, including the actual mask, A-strip connector, finite u/v outside faces, positive axes, connector axes, mixed connector, one corner, signed top/height limit, radial R1 factor, profiles, floors, stars, and the single external M1 normalization, is O_epsilon(X^epsilon) normalized. The alpha mask owns no fresh A=0 residue. The required signed estimate must overcome absolute height capacity U^(c'-1/2-Re z/2) and normalized lattice capacity X^(1/8+o(1)). Pure-comb substitution, coefficientwise cancellation, uniform radial integration by parts, a side-free shift, and all-absolute estimates are invalid substitutes.
update.next_action: Freeze the zero-mass high-pass log-dilation commutator induced by 1-psi(beta), with the bounded-alpha factor, all connectors, signed Plemelj operation, and actual profiles retained; prove its BV/difference estimate or exhibit a sharp floor/lattice obstruction.
Close the explicit projected alpha cosine-Cauchy/GAR-return obligation; the beta branch is already closed and must not be reopened.
Prove the connector-completed projected alpha trace; all radial endpoint, R1 arithmetic, radial-side, and beta-owned interfaces remain closed.

reject.reason: The hierarchical alpha mask is a nonholomorphic log-Mellin projector and creates nonzero strip/area connectors, outside faces, axes, and a corner. The pure comb is recovered only after unmasking or summing the complete mask partition.

At A=0 one has beta=0, while psi is identically one near zero. Therefore Theta_alpha and its first and mixed connector derivatives vanish; the residue -1 belongs to the already accepted global R1 routing.
The minus radial phase sqrt(Xx)-hx/t has the interior stationary point x=Xt^2/(4h^2) whenever it lies in the radial interval. Uniform radial nonstationarity is false.
The unmasked lattice has normalized all-absolute capacity X^(1/8+o(1)), and the terminal height integral has capacity U^(c'-1/2-Re z/2) with positive exponent. Neither is target-sized.

no_change.reason: The exact alpha reduction is promoted, but its projected connector-completed signed estimate and outside-height limit remain open.
Round 49 gives an exact alpha return map and no-go controls, not the M1 estimate.
No unconditional Gauss-circle estimate is claimed.

round_assessment.reason: Round 49 converts the opaque alpha trace into an exact masked cosine-comb architecture, fixes A=0 ownership, and rejects three tempting shortcuts. The target estimate is still open, and the stronger actual-profile GAR return has only non-isolated candidate evidence.
